models.name: qwen2.5:7b
models.purpose: Column meaning, cross-company value mapping, and compiling a sentence into a segment or playbook rule.

measured.notes: A whole spreadsheet is one call, never one call per column. keep_alive is set to 30m so the cold load is paid once per session.

models.name: qwen2.5:3b
models.purpose: Fallback for machines under 8 GB of video memory. Noticeably weaker on unusual header names; the deterministic voters carry more of the result.

measured.notes: Selected automatically by scripts/setup-ai.* when nvidia-smi reports under 8 GB.

environment.PP360_LLM_ENABLED: 1 to use the model, 0 to force the deterministic path. Default 1.
environment.PP360_LLM_KEEP_ALIVE: How long Ollama holds the weights. Default 30m
environment.PP360_LLM_TIMEOUT: Seconds before a generation is abandoned. Default 120

sent_to_the_local_model: the profiler's one-line description of each column
at most three sample values per column
never_sent: salary figures beyond the sampled cells
anything at all over the network
